title: Add guest management functionality to existing bookings

comments.text: Says the addGuests endpoint uses authedProcedure instead of bookingsProcedure, bypassing the booking authorization middleware in util.ts and creating inconsistency with editLocation.
Style suggestion to use .int().positive() for more explicit validation of the bookingId field.
Flags unsafe access to attendees[0] in the subject, which throws if the attendees array is empty. Suggests validation or optional chaining.
Style suggestion to initialize multiEmailValue as an empty array instead of [""], since the empty string is semantically incorrect and causes validation issues.
Notes the Zod schema is duplicated from the backend addGuests.schema.ts and suggests importing it to keep a single source of truth.
Logic issue: reassigning the value prop (value = value || []) mutates props. Suggests using a derived const such as const emails = value || [].
Logic issue: using array index as the React key can cause rendering problems when items are reordered. Suggests unique IDs per entry.
Syntax concern: the variant="button" prop may not be valid for the Button component's interface.
Case-sensitivity issue: blacklisted emails are lowercased but guest emails are not compared in lowercase, so blacklisted addresses could pass through. Suggests lowercasing both sides.
